Zoe (Product): Quick convo: field says upgrades block deals unless we can promise no egress IP churn and a quick revert. Need a tight acceptance list we can share with AE.

Ishan (Eng): Options: 1) in-place operator with service pinning; 2) tenant-by-tenant sidecar canary; 3) blue/green with virtual ingress flip. Tradeoffs are infra cost vs rollback speed.

Renee (Solutions): Field: main constraint = customer egress ACLs. If we change IPs they reject it. Also they want a non-destructive dry-run they can run.

Omar (CS): Customer asks: "no egress change for 80-90% of installs", "ability to abort and revert within 10-15m", "a dry-run that shows diffs only".

Lina (Security): KMS/HSM note: we must surface key-bind status and pause rewraps until customer confirms. Add audit events for any control-plane flip.

Zoe (Product): Draft acceptance criteria:
- installer flag `--preserve-egress` for cloud-supported flows
- `installer --upgrade-dryrun` that reports schema diffs and KMS warnings (no writes)
- revertable < 15m for 90% of tenants when using vpc-core with standby control-plane
- no required DNS changes for vpc-core profile
- explicit manual checklist for airgap installs

Ishan (Eng): I'll run a 3-day spike to validate `--preserve-egress` on AWS/GCP and prototype `--upgrade-dryrun`. Will return cloud caveats and revert timing.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-8555: private-upgrade-preserve-egress-spike (assignee: ishan.k)

Renee (Solutions): I'll draft the installer profile matrix (`vpc-core`, `edge-relay`, `airgap`) and field comms.

Omar (CS): I'll collect 4 customer network examples and map them to profiles.

Lina (Security): I'll add KMS/HSM runbook steps and required audit event names to the ticket.

Zoe (Product): Reconvene next Mon 9am PT to review spike. Thanks :thumbsup:
